title: Cabin Familiarization: Configure the Crew Cabin

steps.hint: It is the panel on your right at chest height, labelled CABIN CONTROL. It holds the cabin systems switches.
The CABIN LIGHTS toggle is top-left on the CABIN CONTROL panel. Flip it up until the label shows ON.
Turn the AIR FAN dial until it points at LOW. Low keeps air circulating while keeping cabin noise down.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the display above the panels. A checklist lists every step so nothing is missed.
COMMS is the panel to the left of CABIN CONTROL. Comms means communications with mission control.
COMMS CHECK is the top button on the COMMS panel. It sends a test call; the READY light turns green and shows READY.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm the cabin is configured.
steps.hint: REPORT is below COMMS CHECK on the COMMS panel. It tells mission control the cabin setup is complete.
